cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late or has it resigned? Choose, so I can organize service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Guests arrive in five minutes. I'll start laying the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not before we decide. Late means plates underneath; resigned means tether each sandwich. Which method are you preparing for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Late. We haven't enough string. I'll fetch the side plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Deep bowls, please. We've chosen returning gravity; prepare for the whole buffet to arrive together.

reason: Make B's urgency and actual plate choice prompt concrete serving corrections under the selected explanation.
